description: Count records in a database, or total/average a numeric field — computed in the database, returning one number. Answers "how many" questions exactly: the count is made in the database, whereas counting the results of query_records, which is paginated, gives the size of one page, not the total. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES count_records"]

database.description: Database name, api slug, or id.

field.description: Field api_name to aggregate. Required for everything except count.

filter.description: Same filter AST as query_records. See also: get_started section "FILTERS".

op.description: Default "count". The others need `field` and aggregate its numeric values.

q.description: Free-text match on the title, same as query_records.

name: count_records
title: Count records
